headline: Policy changes on school resource officers, bomb threats, homeless students, and opioid overdose response.
summary: The agenda lists a review of one policy and possible action on nine others. Items include adopting a School Resource Officer policy and revising policies on bomb threats and homeless students.
items: Review Policy 5141.213, Opioid Overdose Prevention (Emergency Administration of Naloxone)
Rescind Policy 5145.6, Student Grievance Procedures Title IX and Accompanying Appendix A
Rescind Policy 5145.5, Sexual Harassment/Exploitation and Accompanying Appendix A
Adopt Policy 5142.4, School Resource Officer and accompanying Form A
Revise Policy 6164.12, Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS)
Revise Policy 6141.2, Separation of Church and State
location: BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 06010
